I've been gone for thirty years and everything looks very different now. All that is here now are the scars left by the war with Gracia... The beautiful town of my …

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30638-01.html.text: Summoner Basillia: Greetings, traveler. I am Basillia, a Summoner of the Ivory Tower. I was born in this place, but left it over 30 years ago. Let's get down to business, shall we? I know what you're here for... Take out your Arcana Card and prepare for battle! I have already summoned my cat, Mimi.

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30638-05.html.text: Summoner Basillia: Don't be discouraged, the outcome was inevitable. I am invincible!

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30638-06.html.text: Summoner Basillia Haven't you learned that cheating does not lead to victory?

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30638-10.html.text: Summoner Basillia Why are you still here? I assumed that you left for battle with another Summoner...

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30638-02.html.text: Summoner Basillia We can go no further until you get an Arcana Card. Trader Lara of the Town of Dion will make one for you.

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30638-03.html.text: Summoner Basillia: I suppose you know the rules? The first attack shall be made by summoned creatures! No intervention by the Summoners is allowed! Is that clear? Are you ready for battle?

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30638-04.html.text: Summoner Basillia Very well. I accept your card. Your creature may attack Mimi The Cat now!
